paragraphs.text: Vadmir , also known as New Blood , is a vampire rogue from an unknown plane.

Vadmir debuted as a character in Outlaws of Thunder Junction . His history is not known prior to the opening of the Omenpaths in the Multiverse when he crossed over from his home plane into Thunder Junction . He has pale white skin, long sharp nails, wears an somewhat aristocratic outfit with a cowboy hat.
